mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) over the past 3 months indicates rising inflation, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors demand higher risk premiums.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL has increased by more than 0.5% over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0% and the monthly growth in employment (PAYEMS) exceeds 0.5%, it indicates a tight labor market that accelerates inflation and forces the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS > 3.0% and CPIAUCSL > 270), restrictive monetary policy reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS>3.0% and CPIAUCSL>270), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the quarterly GDP (GDPC1) from the previous quarter indicates a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 has declined from the previous quarter, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 indicates a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in residential fixed investment (RSAFS) below 600,000 million dollars indicates a cooling housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS < 600000.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1600.0 thousand units indicates a weakening housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 1600.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
